name: red-regional
description: Atajos para levantar backend (Flask) + app (Expo) juntos

scripts.setup: pip install -r requirements.txt && npm --prefix app install
scripts.dev:app: cross-env EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:5001 EXPO_PUBLIC_DEV_NO_AUTH=1 npm --prefix app run web
scripts.google:app: cross-env EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:5001 npm --prefix app run web
